pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: I WAS RIGHT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHAT!?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHY AREN'T YOU IN CLASS, HACHI-KEN!?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: FAKED BEING SICK TO SKIP OUT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU FAKED WHY YOU!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT HELPS TO BE SUCH A STRAIGHT-ARROW NORMALLY. NOBODY DOUBTS YOU AT TIMES LIKE THIS. AND I'M NOT SKIPPING MUCH, SO CATCHING UP ON STUDIES WILL BE EASY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I FIGURED THAT YOU MIGHT TRY AND SNEAK IN HERE TO GET YOUR STUFF WHEN NOBODY WAS AROUND, SO I WAITED FOR YOU TO SHOW UP AND I WAS RIGHT!

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: Ku ku ku ku...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: OPERATION: Hachiken's Ambush

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: Grr...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ARE YOU REALLY DROP-PING OUT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YEAH. I ALREADY TALKED TO ALL THE TEACHERS ABOUT IT.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BUT... WHY ARE YOU DROP-PING OUT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: DIDN'T THE TEACHER EXPLAIN IT ALREADY? WE CAN'T PAY OFF OUR DEBTS, SO WE LOST THE FARM. I'M DROPPING OUT TO WORK.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BUT YOUR MOM STILL WANTS YOU TO FINISH HIGH SCHOOL, DOESN'T SHE!?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WHY ARE YOU BEING SO STUBBORN ABOUT WORKING?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I HAVE TO WORK TO SAVE UP SOME MONEY.. IF I DON'T, I'LL CAUSE TROUBLE FOR AKI'S FAMILY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THOUGH I ALREADY HAVE, TO BE COMPLETELY HONEST.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AKI'S FAMILY? Why IS THAT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN MY OLD MAN TOOK OUT HIS LOAN TO EXPAND THE FARM,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HE ASKED THEM TO BE HIS CO-SIGNER.
